spec_match.rationale: All presets now use the spec SanitizerConfig shape: per-element attributes on { name, attributes } entries and a flat top-level attributes: [] list (verified on Chromium 157: the old attributes:{href:['a']} throws 'must have a callable @@iterator property'; the new shape keeps <a href> and drops title).

interactive.rationale: Preset cards and Apply re-render with genuinely different output per policy (verified: comment keeps b/i/a[href] and drops p/h2 with content; rich keeps p/h2; strict keeps only a[href]; text-only is empty).

blurb_alignment.rationale: Each preset now restricts output as the blurb promises; the code block and the feature-index snippet use the same valid shape.

edge_cases.rationale: Constructor errors are now surfaced in a role=alert box with the TypeError text and empty output (verified by injecting elements+removeElements). removeElements, replaceWithChildrenElements, removeAttributes, comments, dataAttributes and the Sanitizer mutator methods are still not demonstrated.

references.rationale: Cites chromestatus 5814067399491584 and MDN; no spec link, and the only spec link (feature index / policy-comparator) is https://wicg.github.io/sanitizer-api/, whose abstract now says the draft 'should be no longer consulted' because the API moved into WHATWG HTML.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite runs 7/7 PASS on Chromium 157, but five assertions are existence checks and only one (setHTML strips <script>) is behavioural; nothing asserts on* handler removal, javascript: URL removal, that setHTML stays safe even with a permissive custom config, that a malformed SanitizerConfig throws TypeError, or what Document.parseHTML returns.

runtime_evidence.rationale: All four presets, Apply and an invalid-config injection were exercised with a hostile payload at both viewports: 0 console errors, 0 failed requests, no handler ran, 0 script/img/iframe in the error box. Evidence: Playwright headless Chromium 157.0.8103.78 at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 touch (chrome-devtools-mcp is not available in this environment, so this is NOT DevTools-MCP verification per rule 7b).

telemetry_health.rationale: The shared /public/demo-telemetry.js is injected (runtime/resource errors would be captured) but the page emits no page-specific assertion or interaction events, and /telemetry/demo/events (Basic auth) was not queried in this pass.

design_system.rationale: Uses CSS variables, but the selectable cards are styled divs rather than buttons and the default textarea text shows a literal '<\/script>' escape artefact.

accessibility.rationale: Preset cards are div tabindex=0 with only a click listener, no role and no selected state. Pressing Enter on a focused card does not select it (verified). The textarea is named only by aria-label 'Test input', and output changes are not announced. Accessibility tree not inspected with chrome-devtools-mcp (unavailable).

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No page-level horizontal overflow at 360x740 and the cards stack, but the Apply button is under 44px tall and the cards are not keyboard/touch-semantic controls. Re-checked after the 2026-11-22 fix: deno task responsive-check v146/sanitizer-api reports desktop ok / mobile ok (12 sub-44px targets remain on the feature page) and no page-level overflow at 360x740 for this concept.

openQuestions.title: Make the policy selector keyboard-operable with exposed state
openQuestions.detail: Use buttons with aria-pressed, or a radio group, instead of div tabindex=0 cards that ignore Enter/Space.

openQuestions.title: Add a config-builder concept covering the full SanitizerConfig and the mutator methods
openQuestions.detail: Demonstrate removeElements vs elements (they are mutually exclusive; combining them throws TypeError, verified), replaceWithChildrenElements to keep text from dropped wrappers, removeAttributes, comments/dataAttributes, and the Sanitizer methods allowElement/removeElement/replaceElementWithChildren/allowAttribute/removeAttribute/setComments/setDataAttributes/removeUnsafe, with get() showing the normalised config. allowProcessingInstruction is exposed on Chromium 157; setJavascriptURLs is not, so feature-detect it.

openQuestions.title: Remove the innerHTML-based fallback
openQuestions.detail: Like the XSS demo, the unsupported path regex-strips the input and then assigns innerHTML on a document-owned element, where img load/error handlers can run. Replace it with an honest unsupported state.

openQuestions.title: Re-verify with chrome-devtools-mcp and inspect the accessibility tree
openQuestions.detail: This pass used Playwright headless Chromium 157 because chrome-devtools-mcp was unavailable; repeat the control walk and accessibility-tree inspection through the MCP per rule 7b.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use Element.setHTML()/Document.parseHTML(); custom Sanitizer configs can only restrict; elements not in `elements` are removed with their content; never re-serialise untrusted HTML through innerHTML.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: presets, code sample and feature-index snippet use the spec SanitizerConfig (elements with {name, attributes}; attributes as a list); the innerHTML-based unsupported fallback remains an open question.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Preventative XSS guidance: avoid HTML-string sinks for derived/untrusted data, surface failures rather than silently degrading security behaviour.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: an invalid config no longer silently degrades to the default sanitizer; the error is shown (role=alert) and nothing is rendered.

guidanceConsulted.query: toggle button group aria-pressed selected state
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use native buttons for actions and expose selected/toggled state (aria-pressed or radio semantics) instead of class-only visual state.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Review only: preset/scenario selectors expose selection only via a CSS class; recorded as an open question.

guidanceConsulted.query: live region announcing dynamic log output
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce dynamically changing status/log output through an appropriate live region or <output>, keep native semantics and associated labels for controls.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Review only: the page's changing readouts carry no aria-live/role=status; recorded as an open question.

guidanceConsulted.query: minimum touch target size for buttons on mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep touch targets usable (~44px) and content within its space on narrow viewports.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Review only: measured controls below 44px tall at 360x740; recorded under mobile_desktop_parity.

summary: The custom allow-list concept now works: every preset builds a valid SanitizerConfig and produces distinct output, and constructor errors are shown instead of silently falling back to the default sanitizer. The cards are still not keyboard-operable and the mutator methods are undemonstrated. Verified with Playwright headless Chromium 157, not chrome-devtools-mcp.
